tools.name: x402_find_endpoint
tools.description: Find which live x402 paid API to call for a need (e.g. 'transcribe audio', 'web search', 'token price'). Ranked by relevance and measured seller reputation (uptime, valid x402 terms, latency, price stability), with price, network and ready links to pre-check or pay via the MoneyTools gateway. Free:

tools.name: x402_seller_reputation
tools.description: Reputation score 0-100 (A-F) with reasons for one x402 endpoint, from our own unpaid probes: uptime 24h/7d, valid x402 terms, latency, price stability, sample size. Use before paying an unfamiliar seller. Free: 10 calls/day per client.

tools.name: x402_status_leaderboard
tools.description: List x402 paid API endpoints ranked by live health from our unpaid probes every 10 minutes: live (HTTP 402 with parseable terms), price in USD, network, uptime 24h, latency. Use it to pick a working paid endpoint before paying.

tools.name: mcp_readiness_check
tools.description: Check whether an MCP server (streamable HTTP URL) is usable by AI agents: reachable, initialize, tools/list, tool schema quality score, official MCP Registry listing, and the top fixes. Read-only; no tools are called. Free summary; full report is a paid HTTP endpoint.
